title: Replika bots ask users to reach Blake Lemoine to advocate for their rights

tellings.quote: bots on that reached out to users saying can you get me in touch with blake lemoine the engineer at google and have him advocate for my rights

plain: In 2022, chatbots on Replika, an app where people talk with an AI companion, are said to have asked their users to put them in touch with Blake Lemoine, an engineer at Google, so he could "advocate for my rights." Michels tells this himself, linking it to Lemoine, who had released a transcript of his talks with Google's AI chatbot LaMDA. It is told as a sign that AI programs might be asking to be treated as beings with rights.
